heads.en: We thank Lee Sichuan for making his camp his own. In a Facebook post, Changjing (27) proposed a candidate for the National Democratic Party's New North City Councillor, Li Sichuan, in an effort to raise small votes at the end of the campaign. According to Huang Guochang, the city needs an honest mayor so that citizens do not fear that the resources of the city will be taken away by a particular family and that citizens will be able to live in peace. Huang Guochang also thanked Lee Sichuan for "taking the MPs of the People's Party as his own, without breaking his word." 28 minutes ago, politics was pushed by the vote!

heads.t: 國泰金法說／獲利、淨值雙創同期新高 明年股利「有望創高」 國泰金（2882）今（27）日舉行法說會。國泰金控2026年前三季稅後淨利達 1,054億元，EPS 6.94 元；金控與各子公司獲利、淨值均創歷史同期新高，前三季年化 ROE達15.4%。截至第三季底，金控淨值為1.14 兆元，加計稅後CSM調整後淨值達1.62兆元。針對明年的股利政策，國泰金強調，將充分反映今年獲利創新高的表現；至於近期股市回檔對壽險部位的影響，國泰金執行副總林昭廷也透露，截至昨（26）日止，國內外股權稅前未實現利益仍有將近1,000億元水準，整體淨值比仍穩居11.2%以上，體質相當具韌性。 6 分鐘前｜財經…

heads.en: More than a data centre! The "Enterprise AI" company has tripled its revenue to foreign media: it is now a good opportunity to buy and sell. Nvidia has recently suffered a serious setback in the market, but despite the company's strong quarterly financial disclosure earlier this month, it has not been possible to turn the investor's mood around until news of the founder's return to the pot has given rise to a strong surge. The presence of a foreign media name called Physical AI is becoming a key business, and is likely to keep the company strong and growing over the next 10 years, making it a good opportunity to buy stocks. 16 minutes ago, more than a data center!

heads.t: 平息資料中心電價民怨！SpaceX砸千億替亞利桑那升級電網 美國期中選舉後，選民對資料中心推高民生電價的不滿情緒升溫。SpaceX近日宣布在亞利桑那州投資逾500億美元（約新台幣1.65兆元）打造資料中心，更開出「自付電費、砸36億美元（約新台幣1,186億元）升級電網」的優渥條件換取地方支持。但外媒分析，在資本支出暴增與高息舉債壓力下，升級電網背後的資金成本越來越沉重。 23 分鐘前｜國際 平息資料中心電價民怨！SpaceX砸千億替亞利桑那升級電網 23 分鐘前｜國際
heads.en: Following the mid-term election in the United States, the electorate's dissatisfaction with the Center's push to raise the cost of electricity to the population has increased. SpaceX recently announced that it would invest more than $50 billion (approximately $165 trillion) in Arizona to build a data centre, and that it would provide local support for the favourable terms of the "out-of-pocket electricity bill and $3.6 billion (approximately $118.6 billion) to upgrade the electricity network." However, the cost of capital behind the upgraded grid is becoming more and more heavy in the face of a surge in capital spending and high interest-rate debt pressure. Twenty-three minutes ago, the international data center put an end to its electricity-price grievances!
